questions.text: Do you live in a house or a flat?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is Emma, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. Do you live in a house or a flat?

questions.text: How have you decorated your room?
questions.say: How have you decorated your room?

questions.text: Do you often invite friends to your home?

questions.text: Do you plan to live in a house or a flat in the future?

questions.text: Do you send a lot of text messages?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about texting. Do you send a lot of text messages?

questions.text: Do you prefer texting or phoning?

cueCard.topic: Describe a school you went to when you were younger.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you feel about this school now.

questions.text: Describe a school you went to when you were younger.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a school you went to when you were younger. You should say: where it was; what it looked like; what you did there; and explain how you feel about this school now.

questions.text: Are you still in contact with anyone from this school?
questions.say: Thank you. Are you still in contact with anyone from this school?

questions.text: What makes a school a good school?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a school you went to when you were younger, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all schools. What makes a school a good school?

questions.text: Should schools spend more time on practical skills and less on academic subjects?
questions.say: Should schools spend more time on practical skills and less on academic subjects?

questions.text: How are schools today different from schools in the past?
questions.say: How are schools today different from schools in the past?
Now let's talk about school rules. Why do schools need rules?

questions.text: Should students wear a school uniform? Why or why not?
questions.say: Should students wear a school uniform? Why or why not?

questions.text: Should students be allowed to use their phones at school?
questions.say: Should students be allowed to use their phones at school?
